column1: General duty for each tariff line of Presidential Decree 218/2022 with its amendments, from the Customs Encyclopedia of January 2025 (pages 30-495). The calculator uses it when an HS code is not on the Duty Rates tab: the 8-digit line first, then the 6-digit line. It has no schedule tax, VAT exemptions, agreement rates or conditions, and no changes after January 2025: for those, use customs.gov.eg and the Duty Rates tab. Chapter 24 (tobacco) is not included.
